ja.reading: きょくせんのがいけい

definition_ja: 導関数の符号・凹凸・漸近線などを調べて、曲線のおおまかな形をかくこと。
definition_en: Drawing the general shape of a graph from its derivatives, concavity, and asymptotes.

examples.en: Curve sketching puts it all together: intercepts, critical points, concavity, and asymptotes.
examples.ja: 曲線の概形をかくには、切片・臨界点・凹凸・漸近線をすべて使う。

examples.en: Use calculus to sketch the curve y = x⁴ − 4x³.
examples.ja: 微分を用いて曲線 y = x⁴ − 4x³ の概形をかけ。

pitfalls: AP の CED は topic 5.9 で、f・f′・f″ のグラフどうしの関係を読み取る（connecting a function, its first derivative, and its second derivative）。

sources.title: College Board, AP Calculus AB and BC Course and Exam Description (Effective Fall 2020)
sources.note: Topic 5.9（connecting a function, its first derivative, and its second derivative）
